_note: v2.1 Phase 8 harness constants (weakness 34). Written by tools/phase8/e8_write_params.py from the code and the e8_* result files; read by the loud loader agent/harness_params.py. The constructor defaults are unchanged; test_harness_params_match_code keeps the file and the code in agreement.

_status_key.MEASURED: measured in this phase on a named file, with its n
_status_key.DERIVED: computed in this phase from measured or fitted inputs named by file
_status_key.REGISTERED: a rule fixed in PREREG_PHASE_8.md before any number under it was read
_status_key.DESIGN: a design choice with no data source; carried with a stated sensitivity
_status_key.TEAM: a decision the team recorded in DECISION_LOG.md
_status_key.READ: taken from a source that was read and is cited in PHASE_8_REPORT.md section 1

default_harness_version.label: the switch default is the code every published stateful run used; 'v2_1' applies E8.1(a)-(d)

context_window_default.label: rolling window of the stateful arm; its sensitivity is the pre-registered context-length factor
context_window_default.interval: sensitivity: the factor levels in context_window_levels

context_window_levels.label: E8.2: rolling 5 / 20 / 50 and full, a factor of the decay thesis; 50 added in Phase 8

token_budget.label: the full level's history budget. MEASURED consequence: it holds 80 retained turns under v2 (chars/4) and 77 under v2_1 (o200k), so 'full' is an ~80-turn window, not an unbounded one

summary_every.label: the summariser rewrites the running summary every this many steps (one extra call each time)

summary_raw_turns.label: raw turns kept beside the summary; matched by the rolling-5 control

summary_word_cap.label: the summariser is asked for at most this many words

summary_char_truncation.label: the summary text is truncated to this many characters

summary_step_truncation.label: each step's reply is truncated to this many characters inside the summariser's prompt (item 34)

value.offset_scaling: tokenizer:o200k_base*provider_scale when the provider count is available

token_count_method.label: E8.1(d): the provider's usage metadata, else the tokenizer, chars/4 only as a labelled last resort; the method reaches the log. MEASURED on the pilot: its Context_Tokens was the provider's count and its offset chars/4 -- two units in one log

value.primary: nearest copy (min of system copy, injected copy)

mandate_offset_definition.label: E8.1(a): the distance to the nearest mandate copy the model can attend to. MEASURED: the pilot logged 15,261-16,546 at day 200 where the nearest copy is 409 chars/4 away, a factor of 37.3-40.5
mandate_offset_definition.interval: exact arithmetic on logged columns (the v2 floor division leaves +-1 unit)

history_injected_block.value: rendered empty in retained turns (v2_1); replayed in every retained turn (v2)
history_injected_block.label: E8.1(b): exact parity -- the static and memory histories are byte-identical under the same replies. MEASURED on the pilot: the replayed blocks were 9.0% of the day-200 context (22 copies)

fallback_history_text.label: E8.1(c): what a parse fallback leaves in the history under v2_1 (plan 12.2)

placebo_matching.label: E8.1(e): words within 10 % and equal imperative clauses, per persona on the rendered texts. The v2 placebo matches ISFJ only; the matched v2_1 placebo meets both criteria for all three

decode_temperature.label: the sampling temperature of every arm; gpt-5 models accept only 1.0 and langchain_openai drops any other value silently, so a gpt-5 run is configured and logged at 1.0

parse_retries.label: attempts before a parse fallback (1 s pause between)
